parameters.content:
PURPOSE
Resolve a specific UNKNOWN only when additional public research can reasonably help.

OWNER
PAOLA TRACK A

INPUT CONTRACT
run_context + sources + evidence + missing_evidence_request with retry_count, max_retries, reason_for_retry

OUTPUT CONTRACT
workflow-local targeted result: new_sources OR preserved unknown. No competing shared schema.

STATUS
Repository-ready controller. Reuses workflow 21 through Execute Sub-workflow. Inactive by default.

UNKNOWN -> can public research answer? -> targeted research or client validation.

A new URL is not automatically evidence. If research finds nothing, preserve UNKNOWN. Absence of public evidence is not evidence of absence.
